Notes

[edit | edit source]
  • Bancroft's Talon provides a Stack for every 5% missing health for a maximum of 12 Stacks at 60% missing health
    • each stack provides 5 Intelligence and 0.8 Lifesteal
  • At max Stacks Bancroft's Talon grants:
    • 55(Base)+60(Stacks)=115 Intelligence
    • 7.5%(Base)+10%(Stacks)=17.5% Lifesteal

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • Bancroft's Talon is most likely a reference to Dalton Bancroft, a character from Global Agenda, another game from HiRez[1]
